description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galduwa, Madampagama D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810079 (23/0087)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in Galle District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and encumbrances, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
